name: ralph-loop
description: Standalone ralph refinement loop: check out an existing branch, archive prior tracking docs, record a test baseline, seed a structured focus-area review plan (single-system + paired integration reviews), run the refinement loop until the reviews are satisfied, then open a PR back into the branch being refined.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: base_branch
inputs.description: THE BRANCH TO REFINE. The worktree is cut from it and the PR targets it, so refinement lands back on this branch rather than the repo default.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: Short kebab-case label for the work branch and doc naming. Empty derives a neutral placeholder.

inputs.name: scope_note
inputs.description: Optional free text narrowing or annotating the review scope. The branch diff is always the primary signal; this only adds context.

inputs.name: max_ralph_iterations
inputs.description: Backstop cap on the ralph refinement loop. A seam-based plan of N single-system areas and P paired reviews needs 2N+P passes MINIMUM with zero rework (one observed plan: 26 areas + 112 pairs = 164), and most areas need several passes, so 200 left almost no headroom.

inputs.name: no_progress_streak
inputs.description: Consecutive passes with no forward progress; the loop exits at 2.

inputs.name: teams_webhook_url
inputs.description: Power Automate / Teams webhook for completion alerts. Empty makes the notify steps no-ops.

nodes.label: Init workspace
nodes.description: Clone repo_url at base_branch and create the work branch worktree at {{workspace}}/work.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift init-workspace outputs to top-level vars.

nodes.label: Notify: started
nodes.description: In-app notification that the loop has started.

nodes.label: Derive review scope
nodes.description: Fetch the default branch and compute what this branch changed vs its merge base. init-workspace shallow-clones ONLY the base ref, so origin/main is absent and this must fetch it before any merge-base is possible; falls back to a two-dot diff when the history is too shallow.

nodes.label: Archive prior ralph docs
nodes.description: Copy any existing RALPH.md, docs/reference/focus-areas.md and docs/reference/gaps-identified.md into docs/reference/historical/ with a dated, intra-day-numbered name before they are overwritten.

nodes.label: Capture test baseline
nodes.description: Detect and run the project's test suite(s), writing {{workspace}}/test-baseline.json so the loop gates on NEW failures rather than a green suite.

nodes.label: Record baseline vars
nodes.description: Lift the baseline into test_baseline / test_commands / baseline_summary vars.

nodes.label: Seed ralph tracking docs
nodes.description: Write RALPH.md at the repo root plus docs/reference/focus-areas.md and docs/reference/gaps-identified.md, using the single-system + paired-integration review structure populated with wired-and-fed provenance criteria.

nodes.label: Verify ralph seed
nodes.description: Grep the seeded RALPH.md for the loop terminators before the loop consumes it. Halts rather than retrying: a deterministic grep will not pass on a second attempt.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: push seed
nodes.description: Push the archived docs and the freshly seeded review plan before any refinement starts, so the planning work survives a later crash or cancel.

nodes.label: Refine (ralph pass)
nodes.description: One review area per pass: fix the most important issue, update gaps, commit, push, emit a recommendation, stop. Runs on a cheap high-volume model; it does NOT tick approval boxes — approve-area does, on a different model family, so no agent certifies its own change.

nodes.label: Record pass commit
nodes.description: Reads what the refinement pass actually committed (new commits since the previous pass, whether focus-areas.md / gaps-identified.md were touched) and emits progress_evidence. The assessor is toolless and used to score progress from {{refine.response}} alone — but the pass's Wrap Up asks it what REMAINS, so a compliant report structurally omits what it accomplished and the verdict became a coin flip that tripped the stagnation backstop on healthy runs. A commit is not a narrative. Never fails the run: no git evidence emits a conservative false and the assessor falls back to the pass's Progress: line.

nodes.label: Count review plan
nodes.description: Counts outstanding approval boxes in focus-areas.md and emits plan_complete, so loop termination is arithmetic rather than narrative. refine-assess is toolless: it could only read the pass's own <promise>FINIT</promise> claim and had no way to contradict it. Run ae3ec85f exited that way at pass 56 of a 200 cap with all 112 paired integration reviews untouched — 114 of 164 approvals outstanding — and shipped a PR whose review plan was 70% unexecuted. Fails closed: an unreadable plan emits plan_complete=false, and the stagnation backstop plus the cap still bound the run.

nodes.label: Assess refinement
nodes.description: Read the pass's promise tag as strong evidence, then judge done against the review tables and the branch-point baseline.

nodes.label: Refine loop or exit
nodes.description: Exit ONLY on the iteration cap, a stagnation that survived its rescue pass (streak 3), or a review plan that is arithmetically complete AND regression-free AND assessed done. Order matters: the cap wins outright; then a streak of 2 buys exactly ONE stronger rescue pass per stagnation event (if the rescue also fails the streak reaches 3 and the loop ends); then plan_complete=false and new_failures>=1 each independently force another pass, so no verdict — however confident — can end the loop while approval boxes are unticked or a regression is live. The assessor still decides what counters cannot see (wiring, open gaps), so all of them must agree before exit.

nodes.label: Push & open PR
nodes.description: Push the work branch and open a PR targeting base_branch, so refinement lands back on the branch being refined.

args: Ralph loop complete for {{branch}}: PR {{push-and-pr.pr_url}} opened against {{base_branch}}.

nodes.label: Notify: PR opened
nodes.description: In-app notification that the PR is open.

args: The refinement loop finished and opened a PR ({{push-and-pr.pr_url}}) against {{base_branch}}.

nodes.label: Notify Teams
nodes.description: Rich completion alert (no-op when teams_webhook_url is unset).

nodes.label: Done (terminal)
nodes.description: Terminal node.

nodes.label: Verify tests vs baseline
nodes.description: Deterministic regression gate: runs the pre-detected suite(s) and diffs failures against the branch-point baseline, emitting new_failures/build_broken/confidence. Nothing previously verified a pass's test claims — the agent that made the change also narrated the result, and refine-assess is toolless — so a regression introduced in pass N could be re-narrated as pre-existing in pass N+40 while every later pass built on it. Fails OPEN but LOUD (confidence=low) rather than blocking on unmeasurable evidence.

nodes.label: Approve area (independent)
nodes.description: The ONLY node permitted to tick an approval box. Re-derives the wired-and-fed evidence itself and is hard-blocked from approving while verify-tests reports any new failure or build break. The 2-approval redundancy assumed two independent judgements; with one profile doing both the fix and the approval it was the same model grading itself twice, which is how hollow approvals ship.

nodes.label: Refine (Opus rescue pass)
nodes.description: One stronger pass per stagnation event. Stagnation used to exit the loop and ship the PR with the review plan unfinished; with a cheaper worker that triggers more often. Same mission template, stronger model. If the rescue also makes no progress the streak reaches 3 and the loop exits for real, so this cannot spin.
